findings.detail: X02 is firing on delayed draw and revolver commitment rows where the SOI itself reports dashes for both reference/spread and interest rate, while funded loans for the same issuers carry rates.

rationale: The raw SOI headers include Reference Rate and Spread and Interest Rate columns. For sampled X02 rows, the filing explicitly reports '-' in both columns for delayed draw term loan and revolving credit facility rows with negative cost/fair value or no par, while adjacent funded term loans for the same issuers show normal SOFR/CORRA spreads and interest rates. The stored blank interest_rate/basis_spread therefore matches the source; the warning reflects X02 applying to commitment-style private credit rows whose source terms are intentionally blank.
